game.name: Metal Gear Solid 2: VR Missions
game.rules:
Unless stated otherwise per category, these are game rules that apply to all runs:

- Single Segment only.
- Editing or stitching together runs is **BANNED**.
- Special Items are **BANNED**. This includes Stealth Camouflage, Bandana and Wigs.
- Tools that affect gameplay are **BANNED**. (i.e.: Cheat Engine, Developer Saves, Drebin Mode in V's Fix, Trainers, etc.)
- Emulators are **ALLOWED**.
- Pausing the game is **ALLOWED**, but if you have a long pause in your run, it may be rejected.
- Turbo is **ALLOWED**.
- Runs that are RTA are timed with the following start and end frames:
  - Start Frame: https://tinyurl.com/f8ebss62
  - End Frame: https://tinyurl.com/4mwwmtv8

**Video and Audio Rules:**
- Video proof is **REQUIRED**.
- Audio is **REQUIRED** for full game/character runs.
- Audio is **OPTIONAL** for all individual levels.

**PC Specific Rules:**
- IGT abuse of any kind is **BANNED**. This includes the use of Print-Screen, overloading your CPU, etc.  This does NOT include pausing the game.

If you have questions regarding rules or audio/video quality, contact one of the mods before submitting to review quality.

categories.name: The Document of MGS2 VR
categories.rules:
Complete all 5 Levels of VR in The Document of MGS2. Time starts on the selection of the first level and ends after clicking exit on the last level's score screen. Missions may be done in any order, but you must finish all the missions. Restarts on levels are allowed.

Submit RTA.

**Any%:**
- Finish each mission as fast as possible.

**S-Rank:**
- Finish each mission while also beating the default top score, have no kills, no alerts, no rations used, and no continues.

**Explanation of S-Rank terminology:**
- **DEFAULT TOP SCORE** = The default score for each level that appears on a new save file. You may play on an pre-made save file, but keep the top default score in mind.
- **KILLS** = A kill is counted if a guard dies to lethal weapons, chokes, falling off a rail, etc.
- **RATIONS** = A ration is considered used if one is consumed. Picking up rations does NOT matter.
- **CONTINUES** = A continue is counted if a game-over screen appears. Even if the player clicks EXIT and then re-selects the level, it still counts. Pausing and selecting RESET is allowed.

categories.name: All Missions
categories.rules:
Time starts on the selection of the first level and ends after clicking exit on the last level's score screen. Missions may be done in any order, but you must finish all the missions. Restarts on levels are allowed.

Submit RTA.

categories.name: Highest Score
categories.rules:
**SINGLE LEVEL RULES**

Complete the level(s) with the highest score.

Due to SRDC limitations, please put your score in the **TIME** field as well as the **SCORE** field.
Format your score in the time field as shown:
 - **H:** First 1-3 digits of your score
 - **MS:** Last 3 digits of your score

Example: If your score is 100263, you'd put 100 H, 263 MS, leaving M & S blank.
The time would look like 100 H, 00 M, 00 S, 263 MS.

If your score is under 1,000 points, just fill in the MS field.

For the score field, just put your score.  Click the "Add new value button" to input your score.

categories.name: Fastest Time
categories.rules:
**SINGLE LEVEL RULES**

Complete the level(s) as fast as possible.  Score is NOT a factor when completing these levels.

Submit IGT.

Example: 2:00.00 level, you have 1:56.50 left on completion, you would submit a time of 3s 500ms (3.50 sec).

categories.name: Highest Score
categories.rules:
**SINGLE LEVEL RULES**

Complete the level(s) with the highest score.

Due to SRDC limitations, please put your score in the **TIME** field as well as the **SCORE** field.
Format your score in the time field as shown:
 - **H:** First 1-3 digits of your score
 - **MS:** Last 3 digits of your score

Example: If your score is 100263, you'd put 100 H, 263 MS, leaving M & S blank.
The time would look like 100 H, 00 M, 00 S, 263 MS.

If your score is under 1,000 points, just fill in the MS field.

For the score field, just put your score.  Click the "Add new value button" to input your score.

categories.name: Fastest Time
categories.rules:
**SINGLE LEVEL RULES**

Complete the level(s) as fast as possible.  Score is NOT a factor when completing these levels.

Submit IGT.

Example: 2:00.00 level, you have 1:56.50 left on completion, you would submit a time of 3s 500ms (3.50 sec).

games.name: Metal Gear Solid 2: VR Missions
games.rules:
Unless stated otherwise per category, these are game rules that apply to all runs:

- Single Segment only.
- Editing or stitching together runs is **BANNED**.
- Special Items are **BANNED**. This includes Stealth Camouflage, Bandana and Wigs.
- Tools that affect gameplay are **BANNED**. (i.e.: Cheat Engine, Developer Saves, Drebin Mode in V's Fix, Trainers, etc.)
- Emulators are **ALLOWED**.
- Pausing the game is **ALLOWED**, but if you have a long pause in your run, it may be rejected.
- Turbo is **ALLOWED**.
- Runs that are RTA are timed with the following start and end frames:
  - Start Frame: https://tinyurl.com/f8ebss62
  - End Frame: https://tinyurl.com/4mwwmtv8

**Video and Audio Rules:**
- Video proof is **REQUIRED**.
- Audio is **REQUIRED** for full game/character runs.
- Audio is **OPTIONAL** for all individual levels.

**PC Specific Rules:**
- IGT abuse of any kind is **BANNED**. This includes the use of Print-Screen, overloading your CPU, etc.  This does NOT include pausing the game.

If you have questions regarding rules or audio/video quality, contact one of the mods before submitting to review quality.
